old_problem: C2C names a domain but no error type; no endpoint/link/direction, protocol layer, vendor tool/stimulus, severity/containment, raw evidence, coherent-memory/poison/data-integrity criteria or recovery exists.
disposition_reason: This cannot be parameterized because the intended fault itself is undefined. ED-03/15/16/19 prohibit inheriting SCC Creg assumptions or treating InfiniBand enumeration as proof. Pending/BLOCKED remains until NVIDIA/project defines the exact C2C coverage.
decision_basis: Read exact row113/history2506 and kept it separate from SCC Lockable Creg row112 and baseline GPU rows114-115.
Preserved the generic C2C Error title and both literal TBD fields.
Required source/destination endpoint, protocol layer and typed error before any stimulus.
Required peer availability, coherent ordering, poison and data-hash recovery rather than link presence alone.
No endpoint choice, injection, clear, retrain/reset, recovery, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA C2C typed coherent-link error containment
test_case.purpose: After the error taxonomy is approved, inject one explicitly typed C2C fault on one mapped endpoint pair, prove target-specific detection/containment, and restore peers, coherent traffic, ordering, poison state and data integrity.
required_package: Authoritative C2C error class/protocol-layer definition and NVIDIA tool/spec/version/checksum
Approved synthetic stimulus plus severity/containment/reset semantics
Raw target status/counters and persistent evidence oracle/deadlines
Coherent memory/order/poison/data-integrity/peer criteria, OOB/fabric recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED: no error class or command exists. Do not use InfiniBand inventory or SCC Creg as a substitute. Once NVIDIA supplies a typed target-specific contract, perform fresh review and permit one mapped event only.
test_case.expected_result: The exact endpoint pair records the signed typed C2C event and approved containment, fresh raw/persistent evidence maps to the target, and after recovery all links/peers, coherent traffic, memory ordering, poison state and data hashes are healthy without unrelated impact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while error type, endpoints and Criteria are undefined. Generic logs/inventory, wrong peer/layer, missing raw status, reset/stall, poison propagation, ordering/data mismatch or incomplete restoration fails or remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated non-production coherent topology with disposable hashed workload and independent OOB/console.
Approved typed error, endpoint pair and multi-peer recovery before injection.
Abort on poison propagation, data mismatch, peer/link loss, fabric stall or unexpected reset.
expected_evidence: Approved C2C taxonomy and endpoint/link/lane/direction map
Pinned tool/spec and raw status/counters/peer/coherent-data baseline
Exact one-shot typed stimulus and synchronized endpoint/fabric timeline
Fresh target-specific raw plus firmware/OS/BMC persistent evidence
Approved containment and restored peers/links/ordering/poison/data integrity
test_case.recovery: Preserve first-failure endpoint/fabric evidence, clear only by the approved method, restore tool/debug/link/peer state and verify topology, coherent workload, ordering, poison and data hashes. Use OOB/fabric recovery on instability and never auto-retry.
